Card Q&A.a: Yes, as long as either a Digimon card with [Greymon] or [X Antibody] in its name or a black Tamer card is among the cards revealed, you can add it to your hand.
Card Q&A.q: If the cards revealed only include either a Digimon card with [Greymon] or [X Antibody] in its name or a black Tamer, can I still add a card to my hand using this effect?

Card Q&A.a: No. This card's effect reads “Add 1 card [...] and 1 black Tamer card among them to your hand,” so you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.
Card Q&A.q: If both a Digimon card with [Greymon] or [X Antibody] in its name and a black Tamer are among the cards revealed, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining cards at the bottom of my deck using this effect?

Effect: [On Play][When Digivolving] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Greymon] or [X Antibody] in its name and 1 black Tamer card among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] When this Digimon with [Greymon] or [Omnimon] in its name would be deleted or returned to your hand or deck by an effect, by placing 1 [X Antibody] from this Digimon's digivolution cards at the bottom of its owner's deck, prevent this Digimon from leaving play.
